goal: Prevent wallet history RPCs from fabricating false send entries and negative fees for mixed-input transactions
Ensure accurate accounting for transactions like CoinJoins and Payjoins after rescans or descriptor imports
agreement: Initial NACK on omitting sends was addressed in a rework but not formally withdrawn (achow101)
Support for the reworked approach and avoiding misleading history entries (rkrux, arejula27)
ACK after testing on regtest and suggesting an accounting optimization (Bicaru20)
General support as a needed accounting improvement for multi-user transactions (murchandamus)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes a long-standing bug where history RPCs assume all inputs belong to the wallet
Stops reporting false recipient sends and invalid or negative fees for CoinJoins and Payjoins
